svg.title: I connect people, processes and systems. IT consultant and developer, growing into solution architecture. Animation in three frames: a napkin sketch with handwritten notes (portal, CRM, ERP, billing, data, 'who owns this?', 'AI agent here??'), then the wena logo, then a clean ArchiMate application cooperation view of Portal, CRM, ERP, Identity, Data and Billing with serving and flow relations.
